title: Megaspeed opens probe after reports tying Nvidia’s Jensen Huang to ex-exec
dek: Singapore cloud provider says Alice Huang left in 2025 and has launched an internal investigation after recent reports.
body:
Megaspeed, a Singapore-based cloud computing company, says Alice Huang left the firm in 2025 and has launched an internal probe into reporting about its business. The announcement comes after media reports linked Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to the former Megaspeed executive, and Megaspeed says it is investigating the coverage.

## Why it matters

This matters for money and customers. Megaspeed is under heightened scrutiny that could affect investor confidence, customer contracts and partner relationships. The probe also draws outside attention because the reporting involves a high-profile semiconductor and AI company executive, which raises potential regulatory and reputational stakes.

## The details

- Megaspeed is a Singapore-based cloud computing company.
- Alice Huang left Megaspeed in 2025, the company says.
- Megaspeed has launched an internal investigation into reporting about its business.
- Recent reports linked Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang.
- The company framed the probe as a response to the coverage; further details of the probe have not been released.

## What to watch

Watch for the scope and findings of Megaspeed’s internal investigation, and whether the company discloses a timeline or specific issues under review. Also monitor any public comments from Nvidia or Jensen Huang and whether regulators, customers or investors take formal steps in response to the reporting.

Source: reporting by CNBC.
author: Kelvane Club Desk
